measurement: supplemental Python AST; not SonarQube metrics
loc_method: nonblank, non-comment physical lines in AST class span
cyclomatic_method: sum of direct method McCabe scores; each method starts at 1; decision points: if/for/async-for/while/conditional-expression, except handler, each boolean operator after the first, each comprehension generator/filter, and match alternatives
scope: all tracked Python source files under backend/ and frontend/src/, excluding migrations and __pycache__
